name: QualityGrid Test Runner v4.0C - Manual Review Resolution
description: v4.0C: webhook called by the Google Apps Script HITL trigger when a human marks a Needs Review row as Fail. Normalizes the payload and routes it through the same Jira dedup sub-workflow v4.0B uses.

nodes.name: Webhook - Manual Review Verdict
nodes.notes: Called directly by the Google Apps Script attached to 03_Execution_Results, NOT by v4.0A/v4.0B. Only fires when a human picks 'Fail' in the Manual Verdict dropdown on a Needs Review row - a 'Pass' verdict is written straight to the sheet by Apps Script itself and never reaches this workflow.

workflowId.cachedResultName: QualityGrid - Create Or Update Jira Bug

nodes.notes: Same shared sub-workflow v4.0B uses - dedup logic is identical regardless of whether the Fail came from the automated LLM or a human reviewer.
